public_configuration.scope: Documented EVM mainnets only; not all Aster networks.
public_configuration.validation: Immutable assets; reject duplicate chain/asset, malformed fields, wrong network, invalid EVM address/native flag, zero address, decimals outside 0..255, >5000 rows. Unknown route type is retained without inventing execution support.
public_configuration.address_boundary: Native placeholder is never displayed as a destination. ERC20 address is labeled token contract, not deposit destination. No vault payment address or deposit submission exposed.
public_configuration.lifecycle: Anonymous initial read, manual refresh, five-minute stale marker, retained data on failure, auto-dispose with last route consumer. No invented public time endpoint.

private_withdrawal_info.request: Explicit read only; server time first; nonce/user/signer query and signature appended last. Empty body; redirects disabled.
private_withdrawal_info.signature: EIP712 AsterSignTransaction v1, chainId=1666; message.msg exact encoded query; funding nanosecond nonce (server milliseconds x 1000000), independent monotonic counter, 30-second lifetime.
private_withdrawal_info.signer: Current connected EOA only as user/signer. No additional agent wallet. Acceptance by Aster and trading authorization remain unproven.
private_withdrawal_info.precision: Documented string values parsed directly as Decimal; JSON numbers rejected, missing values unknown, negative reported amounts retained, negative fee rejected. No conversion through double or synthesized final Max.
private_withdrawal_info.lifecycle: No automatic signature. Stop/dispose/scope changes invalidate in-flight operations; 30-second expiry and Spot/Futures account events mark snapshots stale. Route retains snapshot between lazy controls and asset rows. Failed refresh preserves old snapshot; wallet changes clear it.

not_implemented: Actual deposit: wallet native/ERC20 balances, safe network switching, minimum/allowance/approval, exact smallest units, gas, depositFor submission, receipt and platform-credit reconciliation.

Actual withdrawal: verified master-only qualification, fresh final fee and limit checks, business signature plus API signature, confirmation/submission, unknown-outcome recovery and final reconciliation.
Public dynamic fee endpoint is not integrated; displayed fee is the signed withdrawal-info snapshot only.
Spot/Futures and main/subaccount transfer execution; enable-trading; complete Portfolio aggregation.
verification_boundary: Public probes and substitute unit/widget tests only. No device tools, APK install, live private reads, approval, deposit, withdrawal or transfer submissions. iOS requires macOS/Xcode.
